description:
Welcome to Scumtown High! Jaydaddy’s first-ever independent horror-comedy film!

Here’s the best way to support myself and my film:

1. Watch this censored cut of Scumtown High first to help it grow on YouTube!

2. Ask questions in the comments that I will be answering in a Scumtown High Q/A video!

3. Go to https://scumtownhigh.com and watch the Uncensored Director’s Cut to see what you missed!

Film Description:
Written as a one-man show in true Jaydaddy fashion, Jeremiah Mastro’s debut horror-comedy film Scumtown High is a bloody, unhinged ride. After the brutal murder of Scumtown High’s beloved star student Betsy Robbins, Quinn Callaway and his fellow classmates find themselves at the top of Whiteface’s list. They must uncover who’s behind the mask before Whiteface finds them first. Jeremiah Mastro presents, Scumtown High: A Jaydaddy Movie
